 Pelican Rapids man pleads guilty to defrauding IRS
 Fargo, ND, USA / The Mighty 790 KFGO | KFGO 
 News 
 Nov 16, 2026 | 10:12 AM 
 MINNEAPOLIS (KFGO/KBRF) – A Pelican Rapids man has pleaded guilty to conspiring to defraud the IRS.
 The U.S. Department of Justice says Abdulkadir Koosaar aided the preparation of more than 150 false and fraudulent income tax returns for clients.
 Koosaar and other conspirators allegedly used COVID-19 sick and family leave tax credits on the returns that they knew clients were not entitled to claim, resulting in inflated tax refunds.
 The false returns caused a tax loss of more than $750,000.
 Koosaar pleaded guilty Thursday to one count of conspiring to defraud the IRS. He faces a maximum penalty of five years in prison. He also faces a period of supervised release, restitution and monetary penalties.
